theorem erdos_105 :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (A B : Finset (ℝ × ℝ)),
      A.card = n ∧
      B.card = n - 3 ∧
      Disjoint A B ∧
      (¬ ∃ a b c : ℝ,
        (a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0) ∧
        ∀ p ∈ A, a * p.1 + b * p.2 = c) ∧
      (∀ a b c : ℝ,
        (a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0) →
        (∃ p ∈ A, ∃ q ∈ A,
          p ≠ q ∧
          a * p.1 + b * p.2 = c ∧
          a * q.1 + b * q.2 = c) →
        ∃ r ∈ B, a * r.1 + b * r.2 = c) := by
  sorry
